args.message: Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) in round_money, per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
- `round_money` in `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring (and FIN-212) specifying banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py`.
- Changed the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on `08d3cd5986` passed, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.

## Review
Requesting review from @alex (code owner approval required for merge to main).

The PR is open and awaiting alex's code-owner approval — merging into main requires that approval, so I did not merge it.
